slideDecks.note: The course publishes no slides. The Autumn 2024 site, its slides/ path, and the Autumn 2023 and Autumn 2025 archives were checked on 2026-11-01.

textbook.note: The online textbook is a 2025-26 revision, not the text the 2024 lectures used. It is linked in sources.md and was used only to check spellings during the transcript copy-edit. No content is taken from it.

figureAudit.note: false because there is no course material with figures to audit: the KB is built from transcripts alone and writes no figure descriptions.

caveats: Partial coverage: lecture 1 of 8 only. Topic pages draw on lecture 1 alone.
Transcript-only: no slides exist publicly, so several papers shown on the lecture-1 slides are described as the lecture describes them and are not named or cited.

Transcripts were copy-edited by a Sonnet subagent and checked by script (identical timestamp sequence, number inventory, per-paragraph word-count ratio). Lecture 1 has 22 passages marked [Ed: unclear].
